changelog: 1.0.44: titles in a Seerr watchlist were proposed again as outside-library recommendations when their details were not cached yet (each account's requests and watchlist are now always excluded); a later part of a saga outside the library is only proposed once every earlier part, in the library or not, is seen (no more part 5 to someone at part 2); a suggestion found from a title the account only requested now says "Because you're waiting for X" instead of "Because you liked X"; accounts without any known taste no longer get random "little-known gems" from all of TMDb.
description: Personal recommendations that replace Jellyfin's own.
name: Reco+
overview: Personal recommendations (full history, abandoned titles, sagas, Seerr requests, extended mode).
